items.docs: Archives a conversation to the Global Relay Archive. Each request must include a unique requestId (UUID). Conversations can include messages, replies, reactions, edits, deletions, participant joins/leaves, and file transfer events. File attachments must be uploaded via the /files endpoint before being referenced here. Rate limited to 1000 requests per minute.

info.name: Global Relay Upload a file attachment

items.docs: Uploads a file attachment to be referenced in a conversation archive request. Files must be uploaded before they are referenced in a /conversations request with the File_transfer eventType. Rate limited to 100 requests per minute.
